noor: quick catch from today's tempesta-v2-int6 bringup: small but reproducible locale regressions in the multiorient subtitle smoke. two symptoms: (1) CJK vertical punctuation glue (brackets/quotes sticking to ideographs) which shifts vertical columns, (2) RTL bracket/paren mirroring flips in Hebrew/Arabic samples. repro below. :mag:
alex: thanks, paste the exact eval command and a tiny failing snippet so I can run locally.
noor: `rrun eval --model=tempesta-v2-int6 --suite=multiorient_subtitles --subset=zh_vertical,hebrew_rtl,ja_ruby --shards=mini --jobs=6 --log-token-ids --log-detok`

quick output (mini shard):
```
multiorient_subtitles (mini)
- zh_vertical: BLEU baseline=30.4 -> int6=24.2  (regressions 76/250)
- hebrew_rtl: bracket_mirror errs baseline=0 -> int6=22/250
- ja_ruby: ruby-anchor misalign baseline=0 -> int6=9/250
```

noor: minimal repro examples:
```
# zh vertical input: "（田中）
"
baseline detok tokens: ["（","田中","）"]
int6 detok tokens:   ["（田中）"]   # opening bracket glued -> column reflow shift

# hebrew example input: "שלום (עיר)"
baseline decode: "שלום (עיר)"
int6 decode:     "שלום )עיר("  # visual paren flip in RTL render
```

jing: do token ids differ? if tokenizer changed we'd see id diffs.
noor: token ids are identical in the failing cases. added `--log-token-ids` and captured a snippet: `ids=[410,7723,91]` for both compaction on/off, but detok differs.
matt: packaging diffs for int6 we shipped: per-head quant-scale folding, a new kvcache compaction heuristic (aggressive early eviction), and swapped kernel pack to packed-attn-quant. tokenizer/config unchanged.

olga: identical ids + different render usually implies downstream shaping/bidi or detok sensitive to hidden states. compaction changes when KV entries are merged/evicted -> tiny attention drifts can cascade. can you A/B with compaction disabled and a stable quant mode?
noor: ran `--no-kvcache-compaction --force-stable-quant` quick A/B on 200 samples: zh_vertical regressions drop to 6/200, hebrew flips -> 0/200. compaction on alone reduces but doesn't eliminate.

alex: interesting. can you paste a small log with token ids and detok for the failing Hebrew case (compaction on vs off)?
noor: pasted below:
```
# compaction ON
ids: [410,7723,91,55]
detok: "... )עיר("  
# compaction OFF
ids: [410,7723,91,55]
detok: "... (עיר)"
# note: identical ids but different visual ordering when rendered RTL
```

jing: identical ids but different visuals => detok or bidi pass influenced by hidden-state sigs (ZWJ/ZWSP insertion or bracket mirroring classification). can we diff attention mass on the punctuation token across runs?
matt: ran a quick attention-mass diff: attention on the opening bracket token changes by ~12% when compaction runs early, and some head scales differ due to per-head folding. small but plausible to flip detok shaping.

olga: suggested next steps:
- add a tiny multiorient smoke into onboard CI: run ~50-sample shard with zh_vertical + hebrew_rtl + ja_ruby assert checks (no bracket glue, no bracket flips, stable ruby anchor alignment)
- gate aggressive kvcache compaction heuristic for mixed-script/mixed-direction requests (detect and fall back to safe compaction)
- add a build flag `--quant-stability` to disable per-head fold optim for early canaries
- run kernel-only revert (packed-attn-quant -> packed-attn) to confirm kernel interplay

alex: I ran a kernel-only revert locally: packed-attn (non-quant) + compaction triggers fewer failures; packed-attn-quant + compaction reproduces. opening bisect ticket.

noor: I uploaded minimal repro to evals: `/evals/smoke/multiorient/locale_detok_repro_1823456789.txt` and renders under `/evals/smoke/renders/1823456789/` for UX to inspect the visual paren/bracket flips.

eval-bot: canary job queued: tempesta-int6-multiorient-canary #90211 (compaction=false)

jing: I'll start a short hidden-state/attn-diff harness to compute per-token L2 and attention-mass deltas across compaction toggles. matt/olga if you can pair that'd be great.
matt: happy to. I'll also draft a small CI smoke PR to run on int6 candidates. land the smoke first so these regressions are caught pre-merge. :rocket:

noor: filing BR-2001 with logs, hidden-state diffs, and the small bisect plan. tagging eng-runtime, eng-ml, ux, and docs. will follow up with rendered pngs in the ticket. :memo:
